owner: Government of Mongolia (Regional Development Concept / Great Khural 2024)
notes: Mongolia's 2024 Regional Development Concept (official legal act on legalinfo.mn, item 3.3.17; text also on mrt.gov.mn) mandates establishing a regional data center in Mörön city, capital of Hovsgol aimag. Policy-level program item only: no named site, developer, MW, or permit yet. Government horse-program press (ubn.mn) lists Kharkhorum, Khovd, Mörön and Choibalsan as the four regional data-center cities.
